notes: Native-scale arithmetic task means within each family; no average across task families is reported.
Best strand retains the historical per-task choice between forward and reverse complement.
Forward/RC uses the equal-weight geometric mean of aligned nucleotide probabilities, then renormalizes. SV has no such historical readout.
Both FIM presentations use both biological flanks and collapse nucleotide case; metadata presentation uses only verified supported source fields.
These are full original benchmark sets, not the numerical validation subsets. AF and frozen probes are reported separately.
